changes.comment: sdk-ui-dashboard: A dashboard command discarded by a store re-initialization now reports a failure instead of vanishing. A PDF export that had already finished on the backend used to leave "Preparing PDF export..." on screen with the export button disabled until the page was reloaded; a discarded command now emits COMMAND.FAILED with a new CANCELLED reason and rejects the promise of a promise-based caller, whether it was in flight or still queued. Changing the eventHandlers prop no longer rebuilds the dashboard either - added and removed handlers are registered and unregistered by identity.
